selection_algorithm: Within each held-out size stratum, SHA-256 orders its three graphs and assigns low/middle/high within-graph dilution ranks; add alternate endpoints for S1/S3/S5. Training takes low/high selected dilution tasks per size.
selection_rule: held-out graph-stratified by size and low/middle/high dilution without QAOA outcomes

training.rng_rule: stable SHA-256 seed from run identity and evaluation index; fresh sample at every objective call
